prompt:
Fine-line isometric technical illustration in electric cobalt blue (#2D4BFF) ink on a pure white (#FFFFFF) background. Uniform crisp 2px lines, a few flat cobalt fills and very light cobalt tints (#E6EAFF), precise like an engineering drawing crossed with Swiss graphic design. Two to four small four-point sparkle glints (like a twinkle star) in cobalt as accents. Lots of white space, centered composition with generous margins. No text, no letters, no numbers, no people, no robots, no brains, no photography, no gradients, no shadows.
Subject: one isometric block being assembled from a few floating parts snapping into place, with a large four-point sparkle above it.
